name: Rule Templates Processor
description: Applies the first matching rule template to each mail
author: MailFlow community
readme:
# Rule Templates Processor

Registers the processor component id `rules`. Options: `rules` as a list of `{match: {field, contains}, action: {urgency, summary}}` dicts; the first match wins.
